answer: In this PoA design, bonded escrows make equivocation costly: coordination among k identities produces O(k^2) penalties through pairwise evidence, not merely one fee per identity. Detection also compounds asymmetric collateral depreciation, so controlling a sybil swarm imposes an exponential multiplier in capital loss as slashing propagates across linked bonds. A plume of aliases cannot hide at the nadir; the knoll of independent validators is assessed separately.
